the administrative leave and the short-time work are different in terms of their impact on the firm's productivity, and they are also different in terms of the workers' characteristics.
the Russian firms are not hoarding labour, but rather use administrative leaves and short-time employment as a form of internal flexibility.
administrative leaves are used in Russia as a tool to retain employees having firmspecific skills, while short-time work is a tool to retain the workers having low or non-firmspecific skills.
